Kiss the Edge: a one-tap neon drift game

DAY 1October 6, 2026ArcadeRacingRhythmOne-buttonFree · no download
PLAY

Kiss the Edge is a free one-tap drift game you play right in your browser, on your phone or your computer. Your neon car slides through an endless road of hairpin corners and you steer with one finger: hold to drift right, let go to drift left.

The twist is the soundtrack. Every corner you take close to the edge adds a new layer to the synthwave music, so a great run literally sounds better and better until you hit OVERDRIVE. Cut it a little too close, though, and you're off the road.

How to play Kiss the Edge

  1. Tap to start. The car is always moving, so you only choose which way it drifts.
  2. Hold anywhere on the screen to drift right. Let go to drift left. On a computer, hold Space, the right arrow or Enter.
  3. Take every corner as tight as you dare. Passing close to the edge scores GREAT (+2), PERFECT (+3) or INSANE! (+5). A wide, safe corner only scores +1 and resets your streak.
  4. Chain close corners into a streak. At streaks of 2, 4, 7, 11 and 16 the music adds hi-hats, bass, chords, a melody and finally OVERDRIVE, where every corner is worth double.
  5. Leave the road and the run is over. Tap anywhere to retry instantly.

Controls

OnControls
Phone or tabletHold the screen to drift right, release to drift left
ComputerHold Space, → or Enter (or the mouse button) to drift right, release to drift left
RetryTap or click anywhere after a crash

Tips for a higher score

  • Your first runs tell you exactly when to HOLD and when to LET GO. Use them to feel the rhythm of the turns.
  • Turn in late. The closer your drift line passes the edge, the higher the grade.
  • A safe corner costs you your streak, but a crash costs you the whole run. When the music is at full OVERDRIVE, a GREAT is plenty.
  • Grab the gold coins on the road. Every run also pays one coin per 10 points.
  • Spend coins in the GARAGE on 8 cars, from ROOKIE to the rainbow PRISM.
  • Keep going to see new zones: SUNSET BLVD, MIDNIGHT, AURORA, VAPORWAVE, INFERNO and THE VOID.

Kiss the Edge FAQ

Is Kiss the Edge free?

Yes. It's free to play in your browser with no download, no install and no account.

Can I play Kiss the Edge on my phone?

Yes. It was made for phones held upright, and it also works on desktop with the keyboard or mouse.

Do I need sound on?

You can play muted, but the music is half the game: the soundtrack reacts to how close you drive. Turn it up.

What is OVERDRIVE?

Chain 16 close corners in a row and the full track kicks in. While you stay in OVERDRIVE, every corner scores double points.

Is my progress saved?

Your best score, coins and cars are saved in your browser on this device.
